Gold Price Live is a free iOS app released by one of the world's most popular gold websites https://goldprice.org established in 2002.

The latest version features a brand new design and more user-friendly navigation, support for up to 10 languages, and the latest financial news impacting gold prices in English.

Features:

- Latest financial news impacting gold prices

- Live Silver and Gold Price charts in all national currencies, prices update every 1 minute, charts automatically refresh.

- Live Silver and Gold Price tickers in all national currencies, in large font, prices update every 10 seconds automatically. 

- Silver and gold price history charts including 1 day, 3 days, 7 days, 30 days, 60 days, 6 months, 1 year, 2 years, 5 years, 10 years, 15 years, 20 years and up to 46 years.

- Gold Price Charts in these currencies and more: USD, AUD, CAD, GBP, EUR, AED, ARS, BRL, CHF, CNY, COP, HKD, IDR, INR, JPY, KWD, MXN, MYR, NZD, PHP, RUB, SEK, SGD, TRY, VUV, ZAR

- Silver Price Charts in these currencies and more: USD, AUD, CAD, GBP, EUR, BRL, CHF, CNY, HKD, INR, JPY, KWD, MXN, NZD, RUB, TRY, ZAR

- Gold Silver Ratio and Silver Gold Ratio Charts. 

- Find out the maximum Gold and Silver Prices for every national currency. 

- View the Gold Price performance today, 30 days, 6 months, 1 year, 5 years and 20 years for any national currency. 

- View the Silver Price performance today, 30 days, 6 months, 1 year, 5 years and 20 years for any national currency. 

- Save your favorite charts collection then view them all in one convenient place on the home screen of the app.
